backend/main.mo: Implements user registration, encrypted messaging, conversation management, and privacy actions using Map/List structures with authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing frontend files, components, and test IDs supporting end‑to‑end chat functionality.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing major frontend components, hooks, crypto utilities, and state management files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark OKLCH color tokens and global background/text variables.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML scaffold loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component that initializes Internet Identity and switches between sign‑in and chat views.
frontend/src/components/ChatLayout.tsx: Main authenticated layout that registers the user, manages conversations, and renders lists, chat views, and new-chat dialogs.
frontend/src/components/ChayanHeader.tsx: Header with branding, new‑chat trigger, and sign‑out logic that clears caches and conversation state.
frontend/src/features/chat/ConversationV: Displays the selected conversation header, message timeline, composer, and privacy menu.
frontend/src/features/chat/MessageCompos: Text input and send‑button component that submits encrypted messages and handles pending/error states.
frontend/src/features/chat/MessageTimeli: Renders a scrollable timeline of messages with auto-scroll, deletion, timestamps, and undecryptable message handling.
frontend/src/features/contacts/NewChatDi: Provides a dialog for searching users and starting new chats, with selectable search results.
frontend/src/features/conversations/Conv: Displays and sorts conversations, allowing users to select a contact to view messages.
frontend/src/features/messages/useDelete: React Query mutation hook that deletes a message and invalidates the related messages query.
frontend/src/features/messages/useSendMe: Encrypts and sends a message via the backend, then invalidates the conversation’s message query.
frontend/src/features/privacy/Conversati: Menu for clearing local encryption keys or deleting a conversation, with confirmation dialogs and state updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context and hooks for login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for searching users and fetching/decrypting messages using actor and local crypto utilities.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables defining light/dark theme tokens and global layout rules.
frontend/src/lib/crypto/chayanCrypto.ts: Implements simple XOR-based message encryption/decryption and conversation ID generation using localStorage keys.
frontend/src/lib/storage/localKeyStore.t: Manages localStorage-stored encryption keys, with helpers to clear or check conversation keys.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app root with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/screens/SignInScreen.tsx: Sign-in UI using Internet Identity with branding, error display, and security messaging.
frontend/src/state/conversationsStore.ts: Zustand store persisting conversation list and selected contact with add, update, and clear helpers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL or session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theming via CSS variables, extended colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata and lists implemented features for the privacy‑focused chat app chayan, including authentication, contact discovery, encrypted messaging, chat UI, privacy controls, theming, and branding assets.
